message: .npmrc does not match depcurfew.json: `dangerously-allow-all-scripts` is set outside the block that depcurfew manages; depcurfew apply comments it out, and the block sets what depcurfew.json requires
fix: Run depcurfew apply to bring .npmrc back in line with depcurfew.json (depcurfew apply --dry-run shows the change first), or change depcurfew.json if the edit was intended
